source: user-specified acceptance criteria, encoded in analyze_p266_run.py before the full campaign
scope: one ball, empty basket, collection at -3 degrees, corrected P2-61 contact model

hard_criteria.name: ski_takeoff
hard_criteria.rule: measurable upward/rearward takeoff after final ski contact

hard_criteria.name: front_wall_clearance
hard_criteria.rule: no front-wall contact; at least 15 mm geometric margin is required for selection

hard_criteria.name: forbidden_contact
hard_criteria.rule: no contact with chassis, arch, LiDAR, camera, actuator, FIT0186, arm or stops

hard_criteria.name: pre_deflector_ball_top
hard_criteria.rule: ball top <= Z380 mm before deflector

required_physical_gate: measure actual EVA/net restitution before release
